planetGen docs index

Where each page under docs/ is and what it holds. Generated by scripts/build_docs_index.py; the goals are on GitHub.

Generated pages: plans, the TODO and the code map

Rebuilt by scripts from docs/TODO.md, the plan notes and the code; never edited by hand.

  • planetGen Architecture Map generated/architecture-map.html

    The code map: the project's areas, their modules, each module's functions with what calls what, and the main flows traced from the code; open it to find where something lives.

  • planetGen Execution Plan generated/execution-plan.html

    The intergalactic space plan: six lanes of work, the order the stages run in and the open items under each; for the people running the lanes.

  • planetGen Release Roadmap generated/release-roadmap.html

    The releases from 8.1 to 9.3, each with its headline, phases, open items, what it needs and its share finished; read it to see where the project is going.

  • planetGen TODO Reference generated/todo-reference.html

    Every TODO ID ever issued with its full text, status, version phase, prerequisites and what it unblocks, with search and filters; read it to look an item up.

  • planetGen TODO Tree generated/todo-tree.html

    Every open TODO item as a tree, each under the prerequisite that finishes last, with search and filters; read it to see what can start and what each step unblocks.

  • planetGen Version Plan generated/version-plan.html

    Every open TODO item in build order, version by version and phase by phase, with a progress bar per version; read it to see what is built next and what blocks what.

Architecture overview

Written by hand: how the program fits together.

  • planetGen Architecture design/architecture/architecture.html

    The architecture as an illustrated overview: the modules, the main flows, the data and the deployment; for anyone new to the code. The architecture map goes down to functions.

Pages

  • PlanetGen references REFERENCES.html

    Every paper, book, dataset and archive the PlanetGen design and generator cite, in AAS and ADS style, for anyone checking a source.

Reference notes

How to install, run, configure and use the program.

  • API compatibility reference/api-compatibility.md

    The API has a version of its own, one integer that is not the release number (src/planetgen/api/version.py, API.22).

  • planetGen API reference/api.md

    A JSON API over the planetGen database (src/planetgen/db/schema.sql), built with Flask.

  • The atmosphere colour reference/atmosphere-colour.md

    Every planet or moon with a solid surface and air has an **atmosphere colour**: the colour of the light its air scatters down to the ground, shown as a chip and a word ("pale blue", "cream", "orange") in the **Atmosphere Colour** row of ...

  • The atmosphere data model reference/atmosphere-data-model.md

    What a planet or moon stores about its air, which code makes each value, and where the numbers behind it come from.

  • The bulk composition data model reference/bulk-composition-data-model.md

    What a planet or moon is made of in bulk, which stored values record it, and how its mass, radius, density and gravity follow from it.

  • Running CI on your own computers (optional) reference/ci-runners.md

    The CI workflow runs on a schedule (main, and every dev-* branch) and when started by hand (Actions > CI > Run workflow); never on a push or a pull request, and never on a claude/* or claude-* branch.

  • Command-line reference reference/cli.md

    Every option of planetgen, the one entry point for every generator.

  • Deployment Configuration reference/config.md

    This document describes config.json, the single per-deployment configuration file for the whole planetGen project -- the command-line tools (planetgen, planetgen.db.query, planetgen.cli.migrate, planetgen.cli.orbits, planetgen.cli.reset,...

  • planetGen Database Format reference/database-schema.md

    This document describes the MySQL database schema defined in src/planetgen/db/schema.sql.
